features.title: A room photo in, a tip-over verdict out
features.intro: Fall 0 looks at a photo or video of a room and checks whether each piece of furniture could tip when a child climbs it, an older adult grabs it, or the ground shakes. SAM 3.1 outlines the pieces, and a MuJoCo model tests them.

items.name: Snap the room
items.text: The first screen lays out the four steps of a check. Four sample rooms sit above the chat bar to try first, and your own photo, short video or spoken question works too.

items.name: Replay in 3D
items.text: A panel slides in and plays the room in 3D. A child climbs an open drawer, an adult grabs it or an earthquake shakes it, and a piece that tips says how fast it fell.

items.name: Questions and fixes
items.text: The card asks what a photo can't show, such as which floor the room is on. Each fix shows its cost and time, and "I did this" runs the physics again.
